info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Reconciliation Run Termination API
info.description: The Reconciliation Run Termination API allows users to effectively manage and terminate reconciliation processes in a production environment. This endpoint is designed for clients needing to cancel specific reconciliation runs identified by their unique parameters. Typical consumers include finance and accounting teams who require the flexibility to halt ongoing transactions when discrepancies are detected. Leveraging this API ensures efficient oversight of reconciliation activities, maintaining the integrity of financial operations.

delete.summary: Delete a reconciliation run by ID
delete.description: This operation allows users to delete a specific reconciliation run identified by its unique ID. Ensure that the reconciliation run is no longer needed before deletion, as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to delete a reconciliation run identified by the given ID. Ensure that all necessary parameters are correctly provided to successfully execute the deletion operation.

204.description: The request was successful, and there is no content to return.

DeleteReconciliationRunByIdRequest.description: A request body indicating the specifics of the reconciliation run operation when performing a DELETE request.

DeleteReconciliationRunByIdResponse_204.title: Reconciliation Run Response
DeleteReconciliationRunByIdResponse_204.description: This schema represents the response for a successful deletion operation of a reconciliation run. It includes metadata about the operation.

correlationId.description: Identifier for tracking the correlation of the operation.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Contains metadata details of the reconciliation run operation.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme employs a Bearer authentication method, utilizing JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure and stateless communication between the client and server. The client must include the JWT in the Authorization header of each request to successfully access protected resources.
